title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Acts 13: Barnabas and Saul sent out from Antioch, the sorcerer at Paphos, and Paul's sermon in Pisidia.

questions.text: What did the Holy Spirit say while the assembly at Antioch served the Lord and fasted?
questions.explanation: The Holy Spirit said to separate Barnabas and Saul for the work to which he had called them.

answers.text: Go up to Jerusalem and wait there for the promise of the Father
Choose seven men who are full of the Spirit and of wisdom
Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them
Send relief to the brothers who live in Judea by their hands

questions.text: Where did Barnabas and Saul sail to after going down to Seleucia?
questions.explanation: Being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia and from there sailed to Cyprus.

answers.text: Crete
Macedonia
Pamphylia
Cyprus

questions.text: What was the name of the sorcerer and false prophet they found at Paphos?
questions.explanation: They found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus.

answers.text: Bar Jesus
Sergius Paulus
Simeon who was called Niger
Manaen

questions.text: What happened to Elymas the sorcerer when Paul spoke to him?
questions.explanation: Paul said the hand of the Lord was on him and he would be blind, and immediately a mist and darkness fell on him.

answers.text: He fell down and died on the spot
A mist and darkness fell on him and he could not see
He believed and was baptized at once
He fled from the island by ship

questions.text: What did the proconsul do when he saw what was done?
questions.explanation: The proconsul believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

answers.text: He believed, astonished at the teaching of the Lord
He drove Barnabas and Saul out of the city
He commanded that Paul should be beaten
He asked to be taught the magical arts

questions.text: Who departed from Paul's company at Perga and returned to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Acts 13:13 says John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

answers.text: Barnabas
Manaen
John
Sergius Paulus

questions.text: For how long, in Paul's account, did God give them Saul the son of Kish as king?
questions.explanation: Paul said that they asked for a king and God gave them Saul the son of Kish for forty years.

answers.text: Ten years
Thirty years
Seventy years
Forty years

questions.text: What did God testify about David, according to Paul?
questions.explanation: God testified that he had found David the son of Jesse, a man after his heart, who would do all his will.

answers.text: That he would build a house for God's name
That he was a man after God's heart, who would do all his will
That he would never see decay
That he was the least of his father's sons

questions.text: What did Paul and Barnabas say after the Jews contradicted what they spoke?
questions.explanation: They spoke out boldly and said that, since the word was thrust from them, they were turning to the Gentiles.

answers.text: That they would go back up to Jerusalem
That they would stop preaching altogether
That they were now turning to the Gentiles
That they would appeal to the proconsul

questions.text: What did Paul and Barnabas do when they were thrown out of the borders of that region?
questions.explanation: They shook off the dust of their feet against them and came to Iconium.

answers.text: They shook off the dust of their feet and came to Iconium
They sailed back to Cyprus and stayed there
They returned to Jerusalem to the apostles
They went into the synagogue the next Sabbath
